name: [UPD] Don’t Wake the 67! 😴
desc:
A fast paced STEALTH HEIST game.
Sneak in, steal brainrots, and escape before 67 wakes up.

You’ll start stealing within seconds no long tutorials.
Grab as many brainrots as you can, then RUN when 67 notices you 👀

Upgrade your speed, stealth, and escape skills to steal faster and earn more cash 💸
Expand your hideout to store even MORE stolen brainrots 🧠
Trade or gift brainrots with friends and build your chaotic collection 🎁

⚠️ Shhh… don’t wake the 67, or the heist is OVER 🔥
💤 Your brainrots keep earning cash even while you’re offline
